text: A customer disputes a card transaction and expects a provisional credit while the bank investigates.
The customer sees a debit on the account but the payment to the merchant failed, and wants an automatic refund.
A user adds a new beneficiary and large transfers to that beneficiary must wait during a cooling-off period.
A customer withdraws a fixed deposit before maturity and the bank charges a penalty on the interest.
An applicant applies for a retail loan online, the bank verifies income and makes a credit decision.
A new customer opens a savings account through digital KYC with a selfie and ID, and gets tiered limits.
A customer sets up a standing instruction for monthly bill payments and failed payments are retried.
A fraud alert blocks a suspicious transaction and asks the customer to confirm whether it was theirs.
A relationship manager approves a high-value corporate transfer using maker-checker with two approvers.
A customer requests an account statement for a custom date range and downloads it from the app.
A customer raises a complaint about the bank and tracks the resolution against an SLA with escalation.
The savings account allows an overdraft with a daily limit check and charges interest on the overdrawn amount.
Customers send money by UPI to a VPA and the debit happens but the credit is pending after a timeout.
Corporate treasury sends a high-value RTGS transfer after the cut-off and needs approval from the checker.
A new customer completes Aadhaar based e-KYC with PAN to open an account and receives a welcome message.
The customer pays a utility bill by NEFT and wants to see the status and IFSC of the receiving bank.
Send a SEPA credit transfer from the current account to a supplier IBAN with a reference.
The bank wants a chargeback process for card payments where the merchant did not deliver the goods.
A mortgage customer asks to change the EMI date and see the revised repayment schedule.
The customer wants to block a lost debit card from the mobile app and get a new card.
Patients book a clinic appointment online, receive a reminder, and can reschedule up to two hours before.
Customers return items to a store within 30 days with a receipt and get a refund to the original payment method.
Teachers record attendance each morning and parents are notified when a child is absent.
A warehouse picker scans items into totes and the system tells them which aisle to visit next.
An HR manager approves leave requests and employees see their remaining balance.
Visitors sign in at the front desk and the host is notified by message.
A restaurant lets guests reserve a table and pay a deposit by card, refunded if they cancel in time.
Library members reserve books and get an alert when the book is ready to collect.
The support team triages tickets by priority and escalates anything older than two days.
A gym member freezes their membership for a month and billing pauses automatically.
The bank wants a dashboard of overdue loan repayments for the collections team.
Customers can set a transfer limit per day from the web banking portal.
Online shop customers pay by credit card at checkout and receive an invoice by email.
A hotel guest checks in with a QR code and receives a digital key.
The RM sees all accounts of a corporate client and can raise service requests on their behalf.
